scripts.preinstall: node -e "for (const f of ['package-lock.json','yarn.lock']) { try { require('fs').rmSync(f) } catch {} } if (!(process.env.npm_config_user_agent||'').startsWith('pnpm/')) { console.error('Use pnpm instead'); process.exit(1) }"
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
